Joy calls BNP party of Razakars
2014-11-15T00:00:07+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/joy-calls-bnp-party-of-razakars-50446

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's son Sajeeb Wazed Joy yesterday termed BNP a party of Razakars and said its founder Ziaur Rahman was not a freedom fighter. The person who brought back the war criminals cannot be a freedom fighter, and the party which is politically involved with Razakars is a party of Razakars, he said. Addressing a seminar at the capital's Radisson Hotel, Joy dismissed speculations of any compromise with Jamaat-e-Islami that critics expressed after the Supreme Court commuted its leader Delawar Hossain Sayedee's death penalty to imprisonment till death in September.

“If Jamaat was to be saved, had we hanged Quader Mollah ahead of the last elections when US Secretary of State John Kerry and UN Secretary General Ban Ki-moon requested us not to do so? Who had that courage?" asked Joy, also PM's ICT affairs adviser. The trial will go on as long as Awami League is in power, he told the seminar, "Spirit of the Liberation War, Democracy, Development and Good Governance", organised by Shuchinta Foundation. Projecting successes of the government, he said Bangladesh was the fourth fastest growing economy in the world. “We have reduced the poverty rate by half and eliminated militancy in just five years. We are human beings; it's impossible for us to do more in five years.” Referring to media criticism against government's misdeeds, Joy said, "To err is human... Is it possible that there will be no problem in a country of 16 crore people?
